name: Evelyn's Table
address: The Blue Posts, 28 Rupert Street, Soho, London, W1D 6DJ

menus.name: Evening tasting menu
menus.note: Sittings at 6pm and 8:45pm, Monday to Saturday. Pairings: The Path Less Trodden £85, Firm Favourites £150, Half & Half £75, No & Low £60.

menus.name: Lunch menu
menus.note: One sitting at 1pm, Thursday to Saturday. Pairings: The Path Less Trodden £75, Firm Favourites £125, Half & Half £65, No & Low £50.

bookingOpens: Online through SevenRooms. Bookings are released in blocks; at present tables can be booked up to 30 December 2026. The menu and any pairings are paid in advance.

bookingWindow.note: Bookings currently open up to 30 December 2026.

cancellation: The menu and pairings are prepaid. Cancel or reduce the party up to seven days before by emailing hello@evelynstable.co.uk; after that the prepayment is kept unless the seats can be filled from the waitlist.
waitlist: Seats given up after the seven-day cancellation deadline are offered to guests on the waitlist.
groups: The 12-seat counter can be hired for private dining, with a tasting menu and matched drinks; exclusive hires have a 30-day cancellation policy.
